exceptions.reason: Circle CLI 1.1.3 imports Anchor 0.31.1. Anchor parses local Anchor.toml only through its Solana workspace API. Resvary invokes fixed Arc/Gateway CLI commands and accepts no user-supplied TOML or workspace files. Upgrade the upstream chain or remove this dependency before expiry; see docs/dependency-security.md.
